# OTel SIG Meeting Notes — Full LLM Reference

> Extended reference for LLM/agent consumption. For a concise overview, see llms.txt.

## Manifest schema

    GET https://otelminutes.jcosta.dev/manifest.json

### Full example (truncated)

```json
{
  "generated_at": "2026-04-30T08:26:35Z",
  "min_date": "2025-06-16",
  "max_date": "2026-04-30",
  "sigs": [
    {
      "slug": "Collector-SIG",
      "name": "Collector SIG",
      "meeting_notes_url": "https://docs.google.com/document/d/1r2JC14-40VbrB0a_DnPi7g2Z4wMfOJMObxNQLrhcXCk",
      "repository_url": "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector",
      "meeting_count": 28,
      "meetings": [
        {
          "date": "2026-02-25",
          "duration_minutes": 42,
          "has_summary": true,
          "has_meeting_notes": true,
          "trivial": false,
          "participants": ["Alice", "Bob", "Carol"]
        },
        {
          "date": "2026-02-18",
          "duration_minutes": 35,
          "has_summary": true,
          "has_meeting_notes": false,
          "trivial": false,
          "participants": ["Alice", "Dave"]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "slug": "Go-SIG",
      "name": "Go SIG",
      "meeting_notes_url": "https://docs.google.com/document/d/1E5e7W5A6DMTyUh_aPauXNOeqYpN0joG1uss4z7KUCAU",
      "repository_url": "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go",
      "meeting_count": 15,
      "meetings": [
        {
          "date": "2026-02-05",
          "duration_minutes": 33,
          "has_summary": false,
          "has_meeting_notes": true,
          "trivial": false,
          "participants": []
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Field reference

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `generated_at` | string | UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of last build |
| `min_date` | string | Earliest meeting date across all SIGs (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `max_date` | string | Latest meeting date across all SIGs (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `sigs` | array | SIG objects, sorted alphabetically by `slug` |
| `sigs[].slug` | string | URL-safe identifier used in content URLs |
| `sigs[].name` | string | Human-readable display name |
| `sigs[].meeting_notes_url` | string | Google Doc URL for this SIG (may be empty) |
| `sigs[].repository_url` | string | GitHub repo URL (may be empty) |
| `sigs[].meeting_count` | integer | Total number of meetings |
| `sigs[].meetings` | array | Meetings sorted newest-first |
| `sigs[].meetings[].date` | string | ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `sigs[].meetings[].duration_minutes` | integer | Meeting duration in minutes |
| `sigs[].meetings[].has_summary` | boolean | True if AI summary exists |
| `sigs[].meetings[].has_meeting_notes` | boolean | True if meeting notes exist |
| `sigs[].meetings[].trivial` | boolean | True if transcript has fewer than 3 non-blank lines |
| `sigs[].meetings[].participants` | array of strings | Names from the summary's Participants line (empty when no summary) |

## Speaker index schema

    GET https://otelminutes.jcosta.dev/speakers.json

Aggregated cross-reference of all speakers extracted from AI summaries. Allows finding all meetings where a specific person participated without reading individual files.

### Example

```json
{
  "generated_at": "2026-04-30T08:26:35Z",
  "speakers": [
    {
      "name": "Alice",
      "meeting_count": 12,
      "sigs": ["Collector-SIG", "Go-SIG"],
      "meetings": [
        {"sig": "Collector-SIG", "date": "2026-02-25"},
        {"sig": "Go-SIG", "date": "2026-02-05"}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Field reference

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `generated_at` | string | UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of last build |
| `speakers` | array | Speaker objects, sorted alphabetically by name |
| `speakers[].name` | string | Speaker's name as extracted from summary.md |
| `speakers[].meeting_count` | integer | Total meetings this speaker appeared in |
| `speakers[].sigs` | array of strings | Unique SIG slugs this speaker appeared in (sorted) |
| `speakers[].meetings` | array | {sig, date} pairs sorted newest-first |

## Bulk JSONL export schema

    GET https://otelminutes.jcosta.dev/meetings.jsonl

One JSON object per line — every meeting including full summary and meeting-notes text. Ideal for offline analysis, RAG indexing, or building search indexes. Transcripts are omitted (fetch individually via the content URL pattern when needed).

### Example line

```json
{
  "slug": "Collector-SIG",
  "sig_name": "Collector SIG",
  "date": "2026-02-25",
  "duration_minutes": 42,
  "has_summary": true,
  "has_meeting_notes": true,
  "trivial": false,
  "participants": ["Alice", "Bob"],
  "summary": "## Key Topics\n- Discussion on tail sampling...\n\n## Participants\nAlice, Bob",
  "meeting_notes": "## Meeting Notes\n\n### Attendees\n- Alice (Elastic)\n- Bob (Grafana)\n\n### Agenda\n- Tail sampling API review"
}
```

### Field reference

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `slug` | string | SIG URL-safe identifier |
| `sig_name` | string | SIG human-readable display name |
| `date` | string | ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `duration_minutes` | integer | Meeting duration in minutes |
| `has_summary` | boolean | True if summary text is non-empty |
| `has_meeting_notes` | boolean | True if meeting_notes text is non-empty |
| `trivial` | boolean | True if transcript has fewer than 3 non-blank lines |
| `participants` | array of strings | Participant names (empty when no summary) |
| `summary` | string | Full text of summary.md (empty string when none) |
| `meeting_notes` | string | Full text of meeting-notes.md (empty string when none) |

## Content URL pattern

    https://otelminutes.jcosta.dev/content/{slug}/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{file}

Where `{slug}` and `{YYYY-MM-DD}` come from the manifest, and `{file}` is one of:

- `transcript.md` — always exists
- `summary.md` — only when `has_summary` is true
- `meeting-notes.md` — only when `has_meeting_notes` is true

## Example content files

### transcript.md

```
SIG: Collector SIG
Date: 2025-08-05
Duration: 36 minutes
Zoom Recording URL: https://zoom.us/rec/share/6Npj39RLhM7tqtH3qFWGNvOhXg_H8MuFZe9NkheTH-16tKNyqT70GPvdCtun9ojj.tqru4oSoctlJMkJf
============================================================

## Zoom Recording Transcript

**Andrew Wilkins @ Elastic Observability** 01:46 Antoine.
**Antoine Toulme** 01:47 Hello!
Good!
**Dmitrii Anoshin** 03:02 That works.
**Andrew Wilkins @ Elastic Observability** 03:03 Hey dimitri.
**Antoine Toulme** 04:18 Oh, no, because they just upgraded our slack and they turned on AI in slack.
```

**Parsing notes:**
- Lines 1-4 are the header (key: value pairs)
- Line 5 is a separator (`====...`)
- Line 7+ is the body, starting with `## Zoom Recording Transcript`
- Speaker lines: `**Speaker Name** MM:SS utterance text`
- Continuation lines (no speaker prefix) belong to the previous speaker

### meeting-notes.md

```
## Meeting Notes

### Attendees
- Antoine Toulme (Splunk)
- [Andrew Wilkins](mailto:axw@elastic.co) (Elastic)
- Dmitry Anoshin (Splunk)
- Sean Marciniak (Splunk)

### Agenda
- [Andrew] service/telemetry changes & naming
  - https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/4970
- [Antoine] https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/issues/41793
```

**Parsing notes:**
- Attendees: bulleted list, may include markdown links and company names in parentheses
- Agenda: bulleted list, items may be prefixed with `[Name]` and include nested links

### summary.md

```
## Key Topics
- Discussion on the context manager, including the Stack Context Manager and its integration with the SDK.
- Consideration of a default configuration for context management to simplify user experience.
- Challenges with Zone.js and its impact on async context management.

## Action Items
- Explore the feasibility of creating a simplified context manager without Zone.js.
- Review and finalize the PR addressing data loss and context management improvements.

## Participants
Jared Freeze, martinkuba, David Luna Bistuer, Marco Schafer
```

**Parsing notes:**
- Three sections: Key Topics (bulleted), Action Items (bulleted), Participants (comma-separated)
- Generated by GPT-4o-mini from the transcript
- `participants` field in the manifest is extracted from this file

## Query walkthroughs

**Goal:** Find what the Collector SIG discussed about telemetry providers in August 2025.

1. Fetch the manifest:

       GET https://otelminutes.jcosta.dev/manifest.json

2. Find the Collector SIG entry (slug: `Collector-SIG`), filter meetings to August 2025.

3. Fetch the summary for each candidate meeting to identify relevant ones:

       GET .../content/Collector-SIG/2025-08-05/summary.md

4. If the summary confirms relevance, get the full transcript for details:

       GET .../content/Collector-SIG/2025-08-05/transcript.md

**Goal:** Find all meetings where Alice participated.

1. Fetch the speaker index:

       GET https://otelminutes.jcosta.dev/speakers.json

2. Find the entry where `name == "Alice"` — the `meetings` array lists all her appearances with SIG and date.

**Goal:** Build a search index over all meeting summaries.

1. Stream the JSONL export:

       GET https://otelminutes.jcosta.dev/meetings.jsonl

2. Parse each line as a JSON object. The `summary` field contains the full AI summary text. Index `slug`, `date`, `participants`, and `summary` for search.

**Goal:** List all SIGs that met in the last week.

1. Fetch the manifest.
2. For each SIG, check if `meetings[0].date` falls within the last 7 days.
3. Return matching SIG names and their most recent meeting dates.

## Coverage

- Data source: public OTel recordings spreadsheet
- Update frequency: automated on weekdays (GitHub Actions cron at 6 AM UTC)
- Date range: check `min_date` and `max_date` in the manifest
- 58 SIGs, 1,500+ meetings as of April 2026
